visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young adults, two females and one male, stand in a brightly lit indoor living room. They wear Harry Potter-themed school uniforms with V-neck sweaters in red, blue, and green. They excitedly wave wooden wands toward the camera with wide smiles. The background includes a white sofa and a bookshelf filled with figurines and media. (2) A transition occurs to a purple backdrop with a glowing 'Harry Potter' logo. The male and one female pose with wands, while white glowing particle effects appear around them. (3) The scene shifts to a retail store environment. A female with a blue headband browses racks of cream and navy blue sweaters. Camera angles alternate between close-ups of her face and shots of the 'Hogwarts' embroidery on the clothing. (4) Various merchandise items are showcased: themed keychains, circular leather purses, gold-rimmed glasses, and plush owl accessories. The lighting is bright and commercial. (5) The female and male characters are seen holding up shopping bags and customized student cards, posing with a large smile. Heart-shaped graphic overlays appear. (6) They enter a photo booth, and a high-angle shot captures them posing inside. A flash transition leads to them holding up a printed 'Hogwarts' poster. (7) Returning to the living room, the three characters display their purchases. One female looks frustrated as her wand appears to be 'broken' or floppy through a CGI effect, while the others laugh. (8) The video concludes with them posing triumphantly with their wands raised.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins with a strong four-on-the-floor beat. High-pitched female shouting and group cheers erupt simultaneously. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks a transition. A female voice begins an energetic narration in Mandarin, speaking quickly with rising intonation. (3) A series of 'ding' and 'sparkle' sound effects coincide with visual text pop-ups. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm. (4) A mechanical 'shutter click' SFX is heard during the photo booth scene. The female narrator's volume increases as she describes store promotions. (5) Laughter and playful vocalizations from the three main speakers overlap with the music during the final comedic living room sequence. (6) A final 'boing' or comedic rubber-band sound effect occurs as the floppy wand appears visually, followed by more laughter and a musical resolution.
